utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just whatever you can spare helps. I’ll make sure it goes straight to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can spare a little. How do I get it to you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a couple of tools we can use for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Start with the basics: I’ll show you where the tools are, and we can check the first fix together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam at the hall this week. Pia, I can pass along the sign-up times if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please pass them along. I need to make sure I can get there at the right time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll send them over now. The sign-up times at the hall are this Thursday from 5 to 7, and again Saturday morning from 9 to 11.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got a repair drive list here, but I need to check what still needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let me know what’s still on the list, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Uli. I’m telling everyone I can about the repair drive, so expect a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Uli. I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll try to bring a few more people by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I can add your name to the list if you’re able to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put you down. Do you want to help with the morning setup or the actual repairs?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me exactly what needs repairing on the drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, the main thing is the cracked section near the middle of the drive and the loose edging by the curb. I can point out the rest when I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, I’ll keep those two spots in mind and wait to see the rest when you’re there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the details here, and I’ll send them over now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them over and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. Is it the one for the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that’s the one. They’re organizing repairs for the community hall, and I can fill you in on the details I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good - what kind of repairs are they doing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive itself, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, the repair drive itself.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want to talk through what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think that’d help. I keep losing track of what’s left on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, let’s make a quick list of what’s left and go through it one by one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can bring it up with the others and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, then I’ll keep an eye on what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll check in with the others and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting people to pitch in fast. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help a lot. I can come by too and point you to what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll swing by after my errands and help wherever it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to help with that, but I’m a bit foggy on the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I remember the repair drive. I can fill you in after I check the details, and we’ll get you sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, thanks. I’ll wait for your update and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest change, what’s the plan now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think we’re just doing the next batch of repairs now. I can send the current list again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, send me the current list again and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can bring over my drill and a few extra screwdrivers for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can also bring a flashlight and some tape if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still in for the repair drive. Just tell me where you need me, and I’ll show up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do that. Just point me to the first house and I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely. If you need help getting the word out, I can connect a few folks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, Jules. I’m keeping track of the locations, so I’ll let you know where the drive needs support next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, keep me posted and I’ll spread the word to the folks I know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, I’ve got the repair drive on my list. Tell me what’s most urgent, and I’ll help line up the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The most urgent thing is getting the common tools and fasteners counted first, so we know what’s missing before the work starts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll start with the tool count and check the fasteners right after.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s still on for Saturday at the community hall. Bring any small appliance, lamp, or bike part that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — Saturday at the community hall, and I should bring a small appliance, lamp, or bike part if I need help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can take point on pickups and drop-offs if that helps. Just send me the times and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just send me the times and addresses and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether it needs parts, tools, or just a quick look first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let's start with a quick look, and then I can tell whether we need parts or tools.
